sources.snippet: NVFP4 quantization of zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash — Z.ai's 320B / 18B-active natively-multimodal MoE, the first GLM to combine sparse and linear attention — for serving on vLLM. This is a weight-only NVFP4 (NVFP4-A16) checkpoint.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 - Overview - Z.AI DEVELOPER DOCUMENT
sources.snippet: Overview GLM-5.3 is Z.ai's latest flagship model, delivering comprehensive advancements in complex software engineering and agent capabilities. It uses the same base model as GLM-5.2, with all improvements driven by post-training. sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash is a 320B-total / 18B-active multimodal MoE with hybrid KDA and sparse MLA attention, native FP8 weights, MTP, and a 1M-token context window.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 - openlm.ai
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3 is our latest flagship model for coding and long-horizon tasks. It marks a substantial leap in long-horizon task capability over its predecessor GLM-5.1 and delivers that capability on a solid 1M-token context. It is pure open with an MIT open-source license — no regional limits, technical access without borders.
